# Win New Work

Everything between "someone mentioned my name" and a signed agreement: leads, discovery calls, proposals, pricing and pitches. It has no end date because I need four to six clients a year, every year, and the pipeline only works if I keep feeding it while I'm busy.

## Scope

- Leads and where they come from, tracked in the [[client-pipeline-tracker]].
- Qualifying leads ([[qualify-a-new-lead]]) and writing proposals ([[write-a-three-option-proposal]]).
- Pricing: the model, the rates and when each applies ([[pricing-and-scoping]]).
- Pitches and RFPs, won or lost.
- Not here: delivery once a contract is signed ([[deliver-client-work]]), contract terms and invoicing ([[run-the-business]]), the portfolio itself ([[portfolio-and-marketing]]).

## Current State

- Pricing rule since 2026-06-18: $720 day rate for audits, workshops and anything under 10 days; three-option value-based proposals for projects over 10 days ([[pricing-check-in-2026-06-18]], [[services-menu-2026]]).
- The new proposal template is in use since 2026-07-17 ([[proposal-template-2026]]). Tallowmere was the first quote under the new rule: 8 days at $720, deposit paid on 2026-09-10 ([[tallowmere-audit-quote-2026-09]], [[tallowmere-ticketing-audit]]).
- Booked through 2026-11-27 with Copperline transfers and bill pay plus the Tallowmere audit. Nothing signed yet for January 2027 ([[capacity-calendar-2026]]).
- Referrals still bring almost all won work ([[where-2026-clients-came-from]]). I have not answered a cold RFP since Velora ([[should-i-answer-cold-rfps]]).

## Active Projects and Workflows

- [[client-pipeline-tracker]]: updated every Friday afternoon as part of [[solo-weekly-rhythm]].
- [[write-a-three-option-proposal]] and [[qualify-a-new-lead]].
- Completed: [[pricing-model-review]] (2025), [[velora-pitch]] (2026), [[proposal-template-rework]] (2026).

## Next Actions

- [ ] Have at least one signed engagement for January 2027 by 2026-11-30.
- [ ] Send the Q4 update to past clients ([[past-client-update-email-2026-q3]] is the model).
- [ ] Review the $720 day rate in January 2027 ([[when-should-the-day-rate-rise]]).
- [ ] Decide whether to answer any cold RFP before year end ([[should-i-answer-cold-rfps]]).

## Maintenance Log

- 2026-09-10: Tallowmere deposit paid; first engagement at $720 a day.
- 2026-07-17: New proposal template with three options and a paid first step.
- 2026-06-18: Day rate partly back for small work.
- 2025-11-20: Day rates retired for all work in favor of value-based options.
